title: RECAST: REconstruction of Chain-of-Thought via Auditable Structured Traces
abstract: arXiv:2610.41813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large closed-source reasoning models expose only their final answers. The intermediate reasoning that produces those answers is hidden behind API surfaces, tool-call policies, and safety filters. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) extraction methods assume a side channel: a visible reasoning field, a scratchpad carried through tool calls, or a signed/encrypted reasoning block. We reproduce three representative state-of-the-art extraction methods and find that, on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 accessed through the standard chat-completions interface, all three return zero CoT tokens. The failure is structural rather than a bug: the reasoning field is absent, named tool selection is rejected, free-text scratchpad arguments are filtered, and no replayable reasoning block is exposed. translated_title: RECAST：通过可审计的结构化追踪重建思维链
translated_abstract: 大型闭源推理模型只公开其最终答案。产生这些答案的中间推理过程被隐藏在API接口、工具调用策略和安全过滤器之后。现有的思维链（CoT）提取方法均假设存在某种侧信道：可见的推理字段、通过工具调用传递的便签本，或签名/加密的推理块。我们复现了三种具有代表性的最先进提取方法，发现当通过标准聊天补全接口访问Claude-Sonnet-5.5时，三种方法均返回零个CoT token。这种失败是结构性的而非程序缺陷：推理字段不存在，命名工具选择被拒绝，自由文本便签本参数被过滤，且没有暴露任何可重放的推理块。因此，我们采取了一条不同的路线。我们提出了RECAST——一个基于重建的框架，它以问题和目标模型的最终答案为条件驱动解码器，重新构建……
tldr: 针对闭源推理模型中间推理过程完全不可见的结构性问题，RECAST提出了一种基于重建的思维链框架，通过以问题和目标模型的最终答案为条件来重建模型的推理过程，而非依赖不可用的提取侧信道。
en_tdlr: RECAST proposes a reconstruction-based chain-of-thought framework that conditions a decoder on the question and the target model's final answer, overcoming the structural failure of existing CoT extraction methods on closed-source models lacking side channels.
